subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & next steps (Aurelia Tech)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & next steps (Aurelia Tech)

Hi Sophie — great talking earlier. Thanks for the time and for outlining Aurelia's security review needs. Per our call, I put together a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep the SOC 2 package milestone on track. See the proposed milestones and owners below.

High-level goal: complete security review and hand off SOC 2 package to Aurelia for evidence review by end of July; target close for PO/signature by 2026-07-30.

Proposed MAP (milestone / owner / target date / dependencies):
- SOC 2 questionnaire (send to Aurelia): Marissa (Redwood) — 2026-06-26 — dependency: finalize questionnaire version (attached).
- Evidence upload (Redwood to provide artifacts): Dylan (Redwood) — 2026-07-10 — dependency: Dev to export logs and retention policies.
- Security review & clarifications (Aurelia + Redwood): Sophie / Carlos — 2026-07-20 — dependency: receipt of evidence & Q&A thread.
- Contract redlines & approvals: Legal teams — 2026-07-25 — dependency: security sign-off.
- Target close / PO: Commercial — 2026-07-30.

Next steps (please confirm):
1) Sophie — can you confirm owners on your side for Security review (primary + backup) and whether 2026-07-20 is acceptable for completion?
2) Dylan / Dev — can you confirm you can prepare the artifacts listed in the attached checklist by 2026-07-10?

Attachments: AureliaTech_MAP_Draft_v1.docx, SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx (see attachments folder).

I copied Dylan and Dev so they can confirm timelines. Happy to jump on a 15-min sync if you prefer.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & next steps (Aurelia Tech)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick items from our side:

- Security owners: Carlos Mendes (primary) and I (backup). Carlos is our InfoSec lead and will drive the evidence review.
- Timeline: 2026-07-20 for security sign-off looks achievable but contingent on artifact completeness; we'd like a 48-hour buffer for follow-ups.
- Specific asks: can you confirm whether the SOC 2 evidence will include details on: KMS/HSM usage for key management, encryption-at-rest configs (cloud region and key rotation), retention policy for request logs, and sample event logs (last 90 days)? Those are high-priority for our security team.

Also, please include any SOC 2 scope statement (systems in scope) and your auditor name/version if available — that speeds our internal tracker.

We'll review the MAP doc and checklist today and get back with any redlines. If helpful, Carlos can join a brief call with your security/engineering folks next week (Tue or Wed preferred).

Best,
Sophie Li
Head of IT Security, Aurelia Tech
sophie.li@aurelia-tech.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the quick reply and the heads-up on Carlos. Confirming the items below and assigning owners on our side. Please see updated milestone owner assignments and the answers to your evidence questions.

Updated MAP (milestone / owner / target date):
- SOC 2 questionnaire sent to Aurelia: Marissa — 2026-06-26 (sent; copy attached).
- Encryption & KMS details (artifact package): Dev Patel — 2026-07-08 — includes KMS/HSM architecture doc, key rotation policy, and cloud region configs.
- Logs & retention evidence: Dylan Brooks — 2026-07-10 — will provide sample event logs (last 90 days) and S3 retention lifecycle policy.
- Evidence bundle uploaded to secure Share (Redwood -> Aurelia): Dylan — 2026-07-10.
- Security review & clarifications: Carlos / Sophie + Redwood security — 2026-07-20 (48-hour buffer acceptable).

Answers to your specific asks:
- KMS/HSM: Redwood uses customer-managed KMS for private deployments and AWS KMS for hosted accounts. Dev will include the architecture diagram and the HSM integration notes in the artifact bundle.
- Encryption-at-rest: details by region and key rotation cadence will be included in the KMS doc.
- Retention policy & logs: Dylan will export sample request logs (anonymized) and the data retention policy doc.
- SOC 2 scope/auditor: Scope doc and last audit firm (Brightline Audit LLP, report FY2025 Q4) included in the checklist attachment.

Action items for Aurelia: please confirm Carlos as the primary reviewer and let us know preferred times for a 30-min sync the week of 2026-07-06 to walk through the artifact bundle.

Attachments: SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx (updated), AureliaTech_MAP_Draft_v1.docx (with owner assignments).
